package.name: phm_core
package.description: ROS-independent C++ library for the Policy Health Monitor: detector interface, hysteresis, severity bands, rolling-spread calibration and OOD core (plain / Eigen / optional LibTorch kernels), health detectors, worst-wins arbitration, recovery decision logic, synthetic streams, NumPy-compatible random streams and .npy/.npz I/O. Builds with plain CMake as well as colcon.
